name: Airport Starbucks Eggs & Gouda Protein Box (Hacked: Eggs & Cheese Only)
whyItWorks: Available in almost every terminal. Contains two hard-boiled eggs and slices of aged Gouda cheese (naturally very low lactose). By selectively eating the eggs, cheese, and honey/crackers while discarding the raw whole apples and peanut butter packet, you get a clean 20g protein meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Purchase the Eggs & Gouda (or Cheddar) Protein Box. Eat the eggs and cheese; discard the fresh raw apple slices and nut butter if flaring.
